# Product and entitlement contracts

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/product-flow)

Parse provider-neutral digital-product offers and events, and project entitlement state with pure functions.

**Scope:** Contract and reducer code; does not authenticate callbacks, persist state, call providers or accept credentials.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/product-flow`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Strict parsers, entitlement transitions, access/delivery projections and tests are present.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Keep unavailable payment rails explicit and preserve strict event validation. Use the runtime package for persistence orchestration.
